event_data.context: The App approved the schema upgrade, but bundled SQLite reported append errors with the SQLCipher-compatible clock expression. Replacing the clock expression with portable strftime operations and adding an exact migrated timestamp assertion. Running clean builds with both backends before republishing.
event_data.summary: Port and verify the testing tools, examples, and parity verification capabilities of EventCore 2.1.0 on Erlang/OTP.
event_data.title: Testing tools, examples, and parity verification
